messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG illustration of a pelican riding a bicycle. This is a fun creative challenge. Let me think about how to construct this:

1. I need a bicycle - two wheels, frame, handlebars, pedals
2. A pelican - distinctive features are the large beak with pouch, webbed feet, wings, and a rounded body
3. The pelican should appear to be "riding" the bicycle - sitting on the seat, feet near the pedals, wings/hands on handlebars

Let me design this step by step, positioning elements so it looks like the pelican is actively riding the bike. I'll use a side view which works best for this composition.

Let me plan the layout:
- Canvas: about 600x400
- Bicycle centered around x=300, with wheels at roughly x=180 and x=420, y=300
- Pelican body sitting on the seat (around x=300, y=200), with head/neck going up and beak extending forward
- Wings reaching toward handlebars

Let me construct this carefully with nice colors and shapes.
answer:
```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 500" width="700" height="500">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="700" height="500" fill="#e8f4f8"/>
  
  <!-- Road -->
  <rect x="0" y="400" width="700" height="100" fill="#888"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="450" x2="700" y2="450" stroke="#f0e640" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="20,15"/>

  <!-- Rear Wheel -->
  <circle cx="210" cy="370" r="55" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="210" cy="370" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="210" cy="370" r="8" fill="#333"/>
  <!-- Spokes -->
  <line x1="210" y1="320" x2="210" y2="420" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="160" y1="370" x2="260" y2="370" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="175" y1="335" x2="245" y2="405" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="245" y1="335" x2="175" y2="405" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Front Wheel -->
  <circle cx="460" cy="370" r="55" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="460" cy="370" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="460" cy="370" r="8" fill="#333"/>
  <!-- Spokes -->
  <line x1="460" y1="320" x2="460" y2="420" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="410" y1="370" x2="510" y2="370" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="425" y1="335" x2="495" y2="405" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="495" y1="335" x2="425" y2="405" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Frame -->
  <line x1="210" y1="370" x2="310" y2="280" stroke="#d32f2f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="310" y1="280" x2="380" y2="280" stroke="#d32f2f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="380" y1="280" x2="460" y2="370" stroke="#d32f2f" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="310" y1="280" x2="340" y2="370" stroke="#d32f2f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="370" x2="210" y2="370" stroke="#d32f2f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="370" x2="460" y2="370" stroke="#d32f2f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Seat post -->
  <line x1="310" y1="280" x2="305" y2="250" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Seat -->
  <ellipse cx="305" cy="247" rx="20" ry="8" fill="#333"/>

  <!-- Handlebar stem -->
  <line x1="380" y1="280" x2="400" y2="240" stroke="#555" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Handlebars -->
  <path d="M385 240 Q400 225 415 240" fill="none" stroke="#555" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Pedal crank -->
  <circle cx="340" cy="370" r="15" fill="none" stroke="#333" stroke-width="3"/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <line x1="340" y1="370" x2="365" y2="345" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="358" y="338" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#333" transform="rotate(-45 367 342)"/>
  <line x1="340" y1="370" x2="315" y2="395" stroke="#333" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="308" y="390" width="18" height="8" rx="2" fill="#333" transform="rotate(135 317 394)"/>

  <!-- Pelican Body -->
  <ellipse cx="310" cy="210" rx="45" ry="40" fill="#f5f0e0" stroke="#d4c5a0" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Wing (left/reaching to handlebar) -->
  <path d="M330 200 Q370 190 400 230" fill="none" stroke="#d4c5a0" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M330 200 Q370 195 405 232" fill="#e8dcc0" stroke="#c4b090" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Wing feather details -->
  <path d="M360 205 Q380 200 400 225" fill="none" stroke="#c4b090" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <path d="M350 210 Q375 208 395 228" fill="none" stroke="#c4b090" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Wing (right/reaching other handlebar) -->
  <path d="M325 210 Q370 210 395 235" fill="#e8dcc0" stroke="#c4b090" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d="M290 195 Q270 160 260 140" fill="none" stroke="#f5f0e0" stroke-width="18" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M290 195 Q270 160 260 140" fill="none" stroke="#e8dcc0" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="250" cy="130" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#f5f0e0" stroke="#d4c5a0" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Beak -->
  <path d="M235 125 L170 135 Q165 140 170 145 L240 140" fill="#f4a440" stroke="#d4882a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Pouch -->
  <path d="M230 138 Q200 155 175 142" fill="#e89040" stroke="#c87020" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Beak line -->
  <line x1="240" y1="130" x2="175" y2="137" stroke="#c87020" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="248" cy="125" r="4" fill="#222"/>
  <circle cx="249" cy="124" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/>

  <!-- Tail feathers -->
  <path d="M345 200 Q370 190 380 195" fill="none" stroke="#c4b090" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M345 205 Q375 195 385 200" fill="none" stroke="#c4b090" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M345 210 Q372 202 382 208" fill="none" stroke="#c4b090" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Legs/feet on pedals -->
  <path d="M300 240 Q310 300 355 345" fill="none" stroke="#f4a440" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Webbed foot on pedal -->
  <path d="M355 345 L370 335 L365 340 L375 338" fill="#f4a440" stroke="#d4882a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <path d="M320 245 Q330 310 318 390" fill="none" stroke="#f4a440" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Webbed foot on pedal -->
  <path d="M318 390 L305 398 L310 393 L300 400" fill="#f4a440" stroke="#d4882a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Helmet (fun addition) -->
  <path d="M230 112 Q250 100 270 112" fill="#333" stroke="#222" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M230 112 Q250 98 270 112" fill="#e53935" stroke="none"/>

  <!-- Motion lines -->
  <line x1="100" y1="300" x2="140" y2="300" stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="90" y1="320" x2="130" y2="320" stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="110" y1="340" x2="150" y2="340" stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
```

This SVG depicts a pelican riding a bicycle in a side-view, featuring:

- **The pelican** with its characteristic long beak and throat pouch, sitting on the saddle with orange legs reaching down to the pedals and wings gripping the handlebars
- **A red bicycle** with detailed spoke wheels, frame, pedals, and handlebars
- **Fun details** like a tiny red helmet, tail feathers, and motion speed lines to suggest the pelican is riding!
